text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this great? Isn't this fun?! We get to
spend
the whooole day celebrating!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh... Thank you, Urara. But today, well...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was so tired this morning, I could
barely get
myself out of bed. And the
weather says it's going
to rain soon...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I bring nothing but misfortune, even on
my
birthday. So... you should keep your
distance
from me...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whooa! That's amazing—fantastic!
You're so
lucky!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Don't you see? Your bed hugged you
reeeal snug
and tight.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And later, all the drops of rain are
coming down
to wish you a happy
birthday! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Which meeeans... I gotta do my part
too—to
make sure you have the best
birthday ever!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... yeah! Thank you... Thanks so
much, Urara!
